verdict.rationale: Slack's Events API (subscribe to events, Slack calls you) plus Web API (send messages) and app installation ("Add apps to your Slack workspace") provide the building blocks for a bot that can be added to a channel and respond when mentioned, and the App Directory includes AI agents like ChatGPT alongside Slack's own Slackbot AI agent. However, the evidence never explicitly documents the app_mention event, bot channel membership, or an end-to-end example of an AI agent joining a channel and replying only when @mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit app_mention/mention-triggered event documentation, a first-party example of an AI agent bot being added as a channel member and conversing on mention, and independent confirmation this works hands-on.
